query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as sales_count,
  SUM(totalSaleValue) as total_revenue,
  SUM(profit) as gross_profit
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE userId = 1
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
